title: Scaffold Vite project with Tailwind and base layout
description: Initialize Vite project, configure Tailwind CSS with custom design tokens (colors, fonts, spacing from architecture-spec.md), create index.html with sidebar + top bar + content area layout shell. Import Manrope and Inter from Google Fonts. Add Lucide icons via CDN.

criteria.text: Vite dev server runs with HMR
Tailwind configured with custom color tokens from spec (indigo + amber palette)
index.html has sidebar navigation (5 items), top bar with timer placeholder, and content area
Google Fonts (Manrope, Inter) loaded
Lucide icons available
Responsive: sidebar collapses on mobile

title: Implement localStorage data store and service layer
description: Create store.js (localStorage wrapper with caching, error handling, quota monitoring), employeeService.js, projectService.js, and timeEntryService.js with full CRUD operations, validation, and event emission.

criteria.text: store.js handles read/write with try/catch, caches in memory, handles QuotaExceededError
employeeService: create, read, update, delete with validation (name required, max 100 chars, unique check)
projectService: project + task CRUD, status transitions
timeEntryService: CRUD, clockIn > clockOut validation, overlap detection, duration calculation
All services emit events via eventBus on data changes
wtt_ prefix on all localStorage keys

title: Build hash-based router and view switching
description: Create router.js supporting routes: #/dashboard, #/employees, #/projects, #/timesheet, #/reports. Only the active view renders in the content area. Default route is #/dashboard.

criteria.text: Hash-based routing works for all 5 routes
Active sidebar item highlighted on route change
Default route (#/ or empty) redirects to #/dashboard
Unknown routes redirect to #/dashboard
Only active view is in DOM (lazy rendering)

title: Create reusable components: Modal, Toast, DataTable
description: Build modal.js (open/close, form content slot, backdrop click to close, Esc to close), toast.js (success/error/info notifications, auto-dismiss), dataTable.js (sortable columns, filterable, row actions).

criteria.text: Modal opens/closes with 200ms transition, closes on Esc and backdrop click
Toast appears top-right, auto-dismisses after 3s, supports success/error/info variants
DataTable renders from array of objects, supports column sorting (asc/desc), search filter
All components use textContent for user data (XSS prevention)

title: Build utility modules: dates, sanitize, eventBus, export
description: Create dates.js (formatting, duration calculation, locale-aware display), sanitize.js (escapeHTML, input validators), eventBus.js (pub/sub), export.js (CSV with formula injection protection).

criteria.text: dates.js: formatDate, formatTime, formatDuration (Xh Ym), calcDuration, toUTC, toLocal
sanitize.js: escapeHTML function, validateRequired, validateMaxLength, validateEmail, validateTimeRange
eventBus.js: on(), off(), emit() methods working
export.js: generateCSV with double-quote wrapping, formula character prefixing, UTF-8 BOM, download trigger

title: Build Employee Management view
description: Create employees.js view: employee list/grid with status indicators (green/gray dots), today's hours per employee, search/filter by name/department/status. Add Employee button opens modal with form (name, role, department, hourly rate, color). Edit and deactivate via row actions. Progressive empty state CTA.

criteria.text: Employee list displays with color-coded status indicators
Add Employee modal with validation (name required, max 100 chars)
Edit employee via modal, pre-filled with current data
Deactivate/activate toggle works
Search by name filters list in real-time (300ms debounce)
Filter by department and status works
Empty state shows 'Add your first employee' CTA
Today's hours shown per employee

title: Build Project & Task Management view
description: Create projects.js view: project list with color tags, status badges, task count, total hours. Add Project button opens modal. Expand project to see tasks. Add Task inline. Filter by status. Progressive empty state.

criteria.text: Project list with color tags and status badges (active/completed/archived)
Add Project modal with name (required), description, color picker, status
Expand/collapse project shows tasks underneath
Add Task inline within expanded project
Edit/delete project and task actions
Filter by project status works
Total hours logged shown per project
Empty state shows 'Create your first project' CTA

title: Build Timer Widget and Clock In/Out functionality
description: Create timerWidget.js: persistent top-bar component showing active timer (employee name, project, elapsed time, Stop button). Quick clock-in dropdown: select employee → select project → start. Timer updates every second. Timer state saved to localStorage every 30s for crash recovery.

criteria.text: Timer widget visible in top bar across all views
Clock-in: select employee and project, timer starts immediately
Running timer shows employee name, project, elapsed time (HH:MM:SS)
Clock-out: stop button saves time entry with calculated duration
Timer state persisted to localStorage every 30s
Timer recovers on page reload (active timer restored)
Multiple employees can be clocked in simultaneously
Visual indicator changes when timer is active (amber accent)

title: Build Dashboard view
description: Create dashboard.js: summary cards (total hours today, employees clocked in, active projects, entries today), active timers section, quick clock-in button, recent activity timeline (last 10 entries). Progressive empty state for new users.

criteria.text: 4 summary cards with correct real-time data
Active timers section lists all currently clocked-in employees with running time
Quick clock-in button triggers timer widget clock-in flow
Recent activity shows last 10 entries with employee, project, time, duration
Empty state guides new users: 'Welcome! Add your first employee to get started'
Dashboard updates when timer starts/stops (via eventBus)

title: Build Timesheet view with list and manual entry
description: Create timesheet.js: sortable data table of time entries (date, employee, project, task, clock in/out, duration, notes). Add Entry button opens modal for manual entry. Inline edit for quick corrections. Filter bar with date range, employee, project selectors. Delete entry with confirmation.

criteria.text: Time entry table displays all entries sorted by date (newest first)
Sortable by any column (date, employee, project, duration)
Add manual entry modal: employee (required), project (required), task, date, start time, end time, notes
Validation: end time > start time, no overlap with same employee's entries, max 24h
Inline editing of duration and notes
Delete entry with confirmation toast
Filter by date range (presets: Today, This Week, This Month, Custom)
Filter by employee and project dropdowns
Duration displayed as Xh Ym format

title: Build DateRangePicker component
description: Create dateRangePicker.js: presets (Today, This Week, This Month, Last Month, Custom), custom date range with start/end date inputs. Emits date range on change. Used by Timesheet and Reports views.

criteria.text: Preset buttons: Today, This Week, This Month, Last Month, Custom
Custom range shows two date inputs (start, end)
Validates end >= start
Emits selected range via callback
Displays current selection clearly
Styled consistent with design system

title: Build Reports view with charts and filtering
description: Create reports.js: filter bar (report type, date range, employee, project), summary cards (total hours, avg hours/day, top employee, top project), CSS-based horizontal bar chart (hours by employee or by project), detailed data table below chart. Report types: Daily, Weekly, Monthly, By Project.

criteria.text: Report type selector: Daily, Weekly, Monthly, By Project
Filters: date range picker, employee dropdown (all/specific), project dropdown (all/specific)
Summary cards compute correctly: total hours, average hours/day, top employee, top project
CSS horizontal bar chart shows hours distribution (by employee or project depending on report type)
Data table below chart with sortable columns
Daily report: hours per employee for selected date, broken down by project
Weekly report: 7-day breakdown with daily totals per employee
Monthly report: totals per employee and per project for selected month
Project report: total hours per project, breakdown by employee and task

title: Implement CSV export and Print/PDF for reports
description: Add Export CSV button to reports view using export.js utility. CSV includes all visible report data with proper sanitization. Add Print/PDF button using window.print() with print-specific CSS stylesheet. Export button placement: top-right of reports view, prominent.

criteria.text: Export CSV button downloads .csv file with current report data
CSV has proper headers, double-quoted values, formula injection protection
CSV includes UTF-8 BOM for Excel compatibility
Print/PDF button triggers window.print() with clean print layout
Print CSS hides sidebar, nav, buttons — shows only report content
File name includes report type and date range (e.g., weekly-report-2026-03-11-to-2026-03-17.csv)
Export works for all 4 report types

title: Build Settings panel with data management
description: Add a settings section (accessible from gear icon in top bar): Clear All Data button with confirmation, Export All Data (JSON backup), Import Data (JSON file upload with schema validation), storage usage indicator. Optional: display preferences (date format, time format).

criteria.text: Settings panel accessible from top bar gear icon
Clear All Data button with confirmation dialog — wipes all wtt_ keys
Export All Data downloads JSON file with all collections
Import Data accepts JSON file, validates schema, offers merge or replace
Storage usage bar shows approximate localStorage usage
Toast notifications confirm each action

title: Add keyboard shortcuts
description: Implement global keyboard shortcut handler: Space (clock in/out on dashboard), N (new entry), E (employees), P (projects), R (reports), Esc (close modal). Only active when no input is focused.

criteria.text: Space toggles clock in/out when on dashboard (not when input focused)
N opens new time entry modal
E, P, R navigate to respective views
Esc closes any open modal
Shortcuts disabled when typing in input/textarea fields
Optional: keyboard shortcut hint tooltip on hover

title: Responsive design and final polish
description: Ensure all views work well on mobile (640px), tablet (768px), and desktop (1024px+). Sidebar collapses to hamburger on mobile. Tables scroll horizontally on small screens. Timer widget adapts to compact mode. Add loading states, smooth transitions, and micro-interactions per spec.

criteria.text: Sidebar collapses to hamburger menu on mobile
All data tables scroll horizontally on small screens
Timer widget shows compact view on mobile
Dashboard summary cards stack on mobile (2x2 or 1 column)
Modals are full-screen on mobile, centered on desktop
200ms transitions on view switches, modal open/close
No horizontal overflow on any screen size
Print CSS produces clean single-page report output
